integrity: The fixed-matrix gradient-norm criterion is derived directly from the exact coordinate update and the GSL admissible gradient cone. The global condition-number frontier is obtained by an analytic constrained minimization of the two-by-two spectral spread, with an explicit all-larger-condition-number sharpness path and a rational condition-three witness. The standalone checker replays exact and high-precision identities but does not replace the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic one-step classification for two-dimensional real SPD quadratics under single-coordinate Gauss–Southwell–Lipschitz selection with exact coordinate minimization. It does not classify dimensions three and higher, block rules, approximate selection, inexact coordinate minimization, proximal composite objectives, or finite precision.
title: Sharp full-gradient safety frontier for Gauss–Southwell–Lipschitz coordinate minimization
